C01.name: 長い主語
C01.desc: 主語のあとに関係詞・分詞・前置詞句がついて、主語が長くなる文
C01.ex: Files that contain client payment details / are strictly confidential.

C02.name: 後ろに説明が続く
C02.desc: 文の後半に関係詞・分詞・to不定詞・by〜ing などで説明が足される文
C02.ex: ... a new branch in Nairobi, / which will serve clients across East Africa.

C03.name: 理由・条件・時の節が先
C03.desc: Because / If / When / Since / Before などの節が文の頭にくる文
C03.ex: Because the conference hotel was fully booked, / the organizers ...

C04.name: 前置きの言葉が先
C04.desc: Despite / According to / However / In addition / As a result / Beginning May 1 などの前置きから始まる文
C04.ex: Despite rising construction costs, / the board ...

C05.name: 2つの文をつなぐ
C05.desc: and / so / but / whereas / セミコロンで、2つの文をつないだ文
C05.ex: Each session has spaces for only twenty people, / so please sign up early.

C06.name: 受け身が中心
C06.desc: be＋過去分詞（〜される）が文の中心になる文
C06.ex: The elevators / are inspected every six months / by a certified technician.

C07.name: 比べる
C07.desc: more 〜 than / rather 〜 than / compared with などで比べる文
C07.ex: The new standing desks / are far more comfortable / than those ...

C08.name: 質問・依頼
C08.desc: Would / Could / Please で始まる、たずねる・頼む文（質問は文末を上げる）
C08.ex: Could you move me / to the first flight back to Linmouth?

C09.name: 並べる
C09.desc: A, B, and C のように、同じ形のかたまりを並べる文
C09.ex: Coordinators plan itineraries, / book hotels and transportation, / and accompany groups ...

C10.name: 倒置・強調
C10.desc: Hardly had / Only / Not until などで語順が変わる、または強調する文
C10.ex: Hardly had the store opened / when it began receiving more orders ...

C11.name: 情報が前から積み重なる
C11.desc: 主語＋動詞のあとに「何を・どこで・いつ・どうやって」が順に足されていく基本の文
C11.ex: Staff at the center will address / phone and online questions / from customers across the region.

C12.name: that節・whether節
C12.desc: say that / announce that / note that / whether など、「〜ということ」「〜かどうか」が入る文
C12.ex: We are pleased to announce / that Ardent Paper has acquired Lowell Packaging.

C13.name: 名詞のかたまりが主語
C13.desc: The installation of 〜 / Promptly answering 〜 など、動作を表す名詞や〜ingが主語になる文
C13.ex: Promptly answering customer e-mails / has helped Calder Outfitters ...
